descriptor_canonical_checks: row_id must be 0..2999 and strictly increase within a compact phase stream
original16 must be nonzero; zero has no descriptor

dual_replay.completion: phase retires only after both replay accepted counts equal the same sealed active_count and all outstanding responses/FIFO entries drain
dual_replay.per_replay_extent: exactly sealed active_count accepted responses and accepted backend descriptors
dual_replay.rewind: read address and replay_accept_count reset to zero only between replay0 and replay1
dual_replay.zero_active: skip both tile DMAs and both replays, retain tail and phase retirement

exact_backend_reconstruction.distance_field: redundant protection field, recomputed and compared before issue
exact_backend_reconstruction.fallback: when use_pwp=0, ignore center residual for execution and run exact bit-sparse W-times-original16
exact_backend_reconstruction.pop1: every original16 with popcount one is a retained active descriptor and must take fallback; only original16 equal zero may be elided
exact_backend_reconstruction.pwp: plus_mask=original16 AND NOT center16; minus_mask=center16 AND NOT original16; exact result is PWP(center16) plus W-times-plus_mask minus W-times-minus_mask

external_descriptor_sram.correctness_under_backpressure: arbitrary finite request or response backpressure must preserve order/count and may only add explicitly counted stalls
external_descriptor_sram.organization: two alternating banks, each 3000 rows by 48 data bits; one phase-exclusive 1RW port per selected bank is sufficient because matching and replay never overlap
external_descriptor_sram.performance_contract: M377 performance is admitted only after measured SRAM/wrapper stalls are below the reported per-replayed-descriptor budget; a blocking read per descriptor is forbidden
external_descriptor_sram.port_exclusion: descriptor SRAM does not share a cycle-arbitrated port with DMA0, tile data SRAM, pattern SRAM or SHARED96 compute
external_descriptor_sram.read_contract: in-order req_valid/req_ready and rsp_valid/rsp_ready, one complete 48-bit row per accepted response

fail_close_reset_reload.fault_action: enter STICKY_ERROR, suppress further SRAM requests/writes, backend issues and phase-done until reset
fail_close_reset_reload.reload: accepted only in IDLE after reset or clean phase retirement; a fresh all-row match/write is mandatory before replay
fail_close_reset_reload.reset: clear valid state, active_count, FIFO, outstanding/read/write/replay counters and sticky error; SRAM contents become invalid
sticky_faults: row_id out of range, duplicate or non-monotonic
active_count overflow or descriptor write without active retirement
center_id out of q32 range, distance mismatch or nonzero reserved flags
SRAM response without request, response count overflow, FIFO overflow or underflow
replay count mismatch, third replay attempt, tile/context change during replay
reload or bank reuse before clean phase retirement

fifo_and_credit.consume: one descriptor is popped only when the backend accepts its reconstructed exact work bundle
fifo_and_credit.request_issue: issue in monotonically increasing compact address order while credit exists
fifo_and_credit.reservation_rule: fifo_occupancy plus accepted_unreturned_requests must never exceed eight
fifo_and_credit.underflow_overflow: both are sticky protocol errors; backend valid is never fabricated

phase_extent.context_source: sample/operator/partition/tile are phase registers outside the descriptor

serialized_match_and_write.active_count: a phase-local 12-bit counter increments on accepted descriptor writes and is sealed once, one cycle after row2999 retirement
serialized_match_and_write.architecture: one shared q16 matcher slot per cycle; popcount below two retires after first slot and all other rows retire after their second serialized slot
serialized_match_and_write.retirement_bound: at most one source row and therefore at most one compact descriptor write can retire in a cycle
serialized_match_and_write.write_backpressure: the phase-exclusive descriptor write port must accept one write/cycle; otherwise matcher retirement stalls and the exact stall must enter the cycle ledger
serialized_match_and_write.write_rule: desc_w_valid equals row_retire_valid AND original16_nonzero; one write address increments only on accepted active retirement

cycle_risk.interpretation: fixed streaming SRAM latency is a replay-startup term and does not threaten M377; a blocking or shared-port penalty paid per replayed descriptor does

prerequisites: VCS exact miter, assertions and required coverage all pass with exact RTL SHA
post-VCS cycle replay on the frozen ordered population remains at least 1.05x after all controller/SRAM stalls
descriptor SRAM offers one complete 48-bit row response at II1 with fixed latency no greater than eight, or a slower measured interface is charged exactly
reports: 3.0 ns TSMC28 pre-macro DC/STA for controller plus FIFO/wrapper, with setup/hold and unconstrained-path audit
incremental logic area, sequential/combinational split, clock-gating inference and maximum fanout
two 3000x48 SRAM macro area/latency/energy or an explicitly non-paper-ready conservative envelope
SAIF/PTPX after gate-level cycle agreement; no energy or PPA claim from logic-only DC
stop_conditions: any blocking one-cycle-or-more penalty per replayed descriptor that cannot overlap exact compute
shared descriptor/DMA/compute port conflict omitted from the cycle replay
failure to meet 3.0 ns or any unresolved correctness assertion

P1: M377 did not materialize packed 48-bit descriptor bytes, so field packing and corruption checks remain unproved until VCS.
M377 replaces all external SRAM req/resp timing with one startup cycle per replay; it does not prove latency, credit, FIFO or backpressure recurrence.
M377 does not timestamp the one-time active_count seal/commit or prove both replay counts against it.
M377 does not freeze whether descriptor SRAM is independent and phase-exclusive; an uncounted shared-port or blocking per-descriptor access can consume the gain.
P2: The seven flag bits had no canonical meaning; M380 reserves them as zero and requires a sticky fault otherwise.
row_id is phase-local; sample/operator/partition/tile context must remain stable in controller registers.
Aggregate phase work proves at least four compute cycles per descriptor but not real descriptor-order FIFO occupancy; VCS must replay the actual ordered stream.
Logic-only DC cannot make the performance claim; a 3000x48 macro or conservative wrapper timing/area is required.

scorecard.reason_for_not_100: The source population and event ledger are sealed and exact, but there are no packed descriptors, RTL, SRAM transaction trace, ordered FIFO occupancy proof or Synopsys results.
